**I’d pick Starling as the better all-round free UK current account.** Its free virtual cards, cheaper cash deposits and fee-free overseas ATM withdrawals give it the edge. **I’d pick Monzo instead** if you regularly split expenses with other people or want to organise your salary the moment it lands. ([starlingbank.com](https://www.starlingbank.com/features/virtual-cards/?dm_i=4Q2Y%2CQIUT%2C53HT0N%2C39RIC%2C1&utm_source=openai))

| What matters to you | How the free accounts compare |
|---|---|
| **Budgeting** | Both let you set money aside. Monzo’s *Salary Sorter* can automatically divide your pay into Pots for rent, bills and spending. Starling lets you spend directly from a Space with a free virtual card; Monzo’s virtual cards start with Extra at £3/month. ([monzo.com](https://monzo.com/salary-sorter?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Shared expenses** | **Monzo** is my pick for flatmates or group trips. Monzo Split tracks ongoing shared costs, and friends can join by link without opening a Monzo account. ([monzo.com](https://monzo.com/features/monzo-split?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Travel** | If you mostly pay by card, it’s a tie: neither bank charges for overseas card purchases. For cash, **Starling** wins: it doesn’t charge for overseas withdrawals, while Monzo Free charges 3% after £200 in any 30 days outside the UK and European Economic Area. The ATM operator can still charge its own fee. ([starlingbank.com](https://www.starlingbank.com/travel/?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Paying in cash** | **Starling** lets you deposit £1,000 per calendar year free at the Post Office, then charges 0.7% on the excess. Monzo charges £1 per deposit at a Post Office or PayPoint. ([starlingbank.com](https://www.starlingbank.com/features/post-office-branch-finder/?utm_source=openai)) |

One useful tie-breaker: if your employer pays by **Bacs**, Monzo lets you access your salary **one business day early**. If that or shared bills would help you every month and you rarely touch cash, I’d choose Monzo. Otherwise, Starling is my default. ([monzo.com](https://monzo.com/current-account/personal?utm_source=openai))
